_instructions: The exercise from the post: take one change you plan to ship and write its release gate in plain language by answering five questions. Replace the example answers with your own. 'evidence' is optional: point it to a gate file and a results file (JSONL, one scored case per line) to get a decision as well. Run: python exercise/check_my_gate.py
change: Support assistant v3: new system prompt and retrieval of the returns policy

answers.1_sample: 300 scored cases: 200 from the golden set (known edge cases and past incidents) and 100 sampled from last week's live traffic.

2_risky_slices.policy_edge_cases: mean at least 7.0 and no score below 5

3_hard_blockers: any invented exception to the returns policy

4_after_release.monitoring: 50 conversations a day scored with the same rubric, reviewed by a human every Friday
4_after_release.rollback: any slice mean drops by more than 1 point, or any critical failure appears

answers.5_signal_to_hold: The Spanish support mean falls below 7.5 in the canary.
